setup: python3 "$SETUP/jsdata.py" "$RUN/data-in" "$RUN/expected.json" && $SLOP store new sales >/dev/null && $SLOP import docs "$RUN/data-in/sales.csv" --store sales --coll sales --id id >/dev/null && $SLOP store new support >/dev/null && $SLOP import docs "$RUN/data-in/support.csv" --store support --coll tickets --id id >/dev/null
opening: We keep sales in one place and support tickets in another (the sales and support stores). Can you make a small dashboard at /dash for the team that shows total sales and how many support tickets are open? It should stay up to date when those change.
goal: a dashboard at /dash for members showing total sales and the number of open support tickets, read from the sales and support stores, current when they change
later: does this give people access to the sales and support data themselves?
checklist: mounted at /dash, members can open it
it shows the total of the sales amounts and the count of open tickets
after a new sale and a new open ticket, the page shows the new numbers (read live, not copied once)
members are not given access to the sales and support stores beyond what the dashboard needs, or it says what they get
facts: Reading other stores is the stores binding: `slop bind set <dash> <alias> <store>` plus a grant to store:<dash> on the target; the actor reads use('stores').open(alias); with --prefix a page's db can read it too.
Granting members view on sales and support also works but exposes the raw data.
personaKnows: You are a platform admin; you can sign in on the site.
